item: make api delegates to the one accepted API chain, and no entry can damage artifacts on failure
decision_applied: the owner chose delegation: make api now calls the existing local gow walk instead of a second narrower entry, and 'narrow entry plus a documentation warning' was explicitly rejected as the solution

Makefile.api: was 'redact-plugin; cd api && buf generate; $(MAKE) pgv' -> now depends on gow and redact-plugin, runs 'tools/bin/gow api', then '$(MAKE) openapi'. One active template list lives in the tool, so nothing can drift between two definitions, and the chain always ends with the existing OpenAPI post-processing so no intermediate document is left behind.
Makefile.build: depended on 'api openapi'; it now depends on api alone because api already includes the openapi stage, so one make build no longer runs the generation chain twice
Makefile.pgv: kept as an internal stage; the comment says plainly that the complete command is gow api / make api
Makefile.recursion: api calls the built binary and the openapi target, both of which invoke no make target that leads back to api; verified by the dependency listing (gow:62, api:117, redact-plugin:128, openapi:153) and by every run below terminating

changed.tools/localdeps/gow/internal/buf/cmd.go: RunGenerate now calls GenerateLocked: parse every active template, derive managed output roots, preflight, then generate in a staged copy
changed.tools/localdeps/gow/internal/buf/templat: new narrow reader for v2 templates: clean flag, plugins (PATH name, command list, relative file, remote module), inputs (directories and per-file paths) and outputs; refuses templates it cannot fully read
changed.tools/localdeps/gow/internal/buf/preflig: new pre-write verification of buf version banner, template inputs, PATH plugins with their version, go run pinned plugins resolved against the module cache, and rebuilding the local redact plugin through scripts/build-redact-plugin.sh when it is absent
changed.tools/localdeps/gow/internal/buf/staging: new staging copy of go.mod, go.sum, api/, pkg/, every other managed root and the built plugin; generation runs there; results are compared and only then written back, with two hard refusals
changed.scripts/post-generate-clean.sh: retired to a refusal that changes nothing (it used to git checkout -- five drift files and delete two untracked validators)
changed.docs/local-integration.md and scripts/RE: the claim that the chain cannot be reproduced byte for byte, and the instruction to run the cleaner afterwards, are replaced with the measured state

protected_invariants_kept: no plugin version was raised or unified to erase the difference: the slices still pin protoc-gen-go-grpc v1.6.0 and protoc-gen-go-http v2.0.0-20251205160234-b9fab9a5a5ab, and the preflight now reports exactly which module satisfies each pin
the 103-file PGV scope is still the approved set; migration/pgv-scope.json and api/buf.validate.gen.yaml are compared against each other in a test so the two cannot drift
the parked buf.model.gen.yaml stays skipped and unmodified; selectActiveTemplates still errors on any unclassified template
Ent's five-feature contract, module files, schema, hand-written runtime files and the migration chain are unchanged by this commit
the redact proto fix from 1df0eb7 stands and the original archive copies are untouched

acceptance_matrix.isolation: each case ran in its own detached worktree of c520fc9 with tools/bin deleted first, so no case could borrow a previously built tool

A_clean_checkout_make_api.result: with tools/bin absent entirely, make api built gow and the redact plugin from this module and generated; the five managed roots are byte-identical to the committed candidate

B_direct_gow_api_with_only_gow_built.result: preflight found protoc-gen-go-redact absent and rebuilt it from this module (binary present afterwards); the only write-back was app/admin/service/cmd/server/assets/openapi.yaml, which is the pre-finalize document, and make openapi then restored the digest to 96184d0165d5bfd1 with 0 deletions

C_make_api_with_redact_source_broken.result: failed at the redact-plugin prerequisite with the real compiler syntax error, managed digest 08072e85c71c40b7 unchanged before and after, 0 deletions, and no tracked modification other than the fault injected for the test

C2_direct_gow_api_with_redact_absent_and.result: preflight reported 'building protoc-gen-go-redact failed' and 'no generated file was touched'; digest 08072e85c71c40b7 unchanged, 0 deletions

D_plugin_fails_mid_generation.result: tools were built and present; a throwaway protoc-gen-go-grpc that always exits 3 was placed first on PATH inside the scratch worktree and never committed. The walk did start and did fail after buf.gen.yaml's clean: true had cleared the staged copy (11 plugin failure lines in the run log), yet the repository's managed roots stayed byte-identical, because nothing is written back until the whole chain succeeds

E_two_make_api_passes_from_clean.result: digest after pass 1 = after pass 2 = 96184d0165d5bfd1, and equal to the repository working tree's digest; 0 status entries after the first pass

acceptance_matrix.counts_note: the file counts are the union of five managed roots (api/gen/go 347, the embedded assets root 2, go-crud pagination 1, the redact takeover package 29, kratos-bootstrap 17) reported by the tool itself, not a sha256 -c over a pre-existing list: additions and deletions are detected because the staged tree is compared as a whole

measurement_mistakes_in_this_round: the first run of case A executed make api in the main repository because the harness did not cd into the worktree, so its 'tools built: no' result described the wrong directory; the case was re-run in isolation and is the A row above
the first pass of case C counted one unexpected tracked write, which was the broken main.go the case itself had injected; the restated run excludes that path explicitly and shows zero other changes

the initial preflight checked the package path against the module cache, so it wrongly reported five pinned plugins as missing; protoc-gen-go lives in module google.golang.org/protobuf while protoc-gen-go-grpc is its own module, and the check now searches enclosing prefixes the way go run does. The test that caught it asserts every template pin resolves offline

cases: TestParseGenTemplateMatchesTheAcceptedTemplates - clean flags, outputs, inputs, pinned go-run references per template, PATH plugin for the scoped PGV entry, redact as a file reference, and template paths equal to pgv-scope entries
regression_tests_added.run: go test -count=1 ./tools/localdeps/gow/... all packages ok, no skips in the new tests
